title: Static Hunched Shoulder Bare Neck and Ruff Vulture
description: One newly authored complete stylised vulture-like bird in a fixed grounded stance. A high broad hunched shoulder torso carries two long drooping folded wings and a modest short rear tail. A pale complete feather ruff surrounds the root of a conspicuously slender bare recurved neck leading to a small bald head and short down-hook bill. Two short bare bent legs join full toe-cleft feet. All whole body sections and limb/head outlines new, not old parrot arrays with a different beak or pelican pouch removed. One model zero scenes. Stylised static exterior only, not precise species, feather or anatomy simulation, feeding, flight, rig, animation, biology or safety claim.
